limitations: The initial broad Runtime run failed, including unrelated Linux/macOS platform assumptions and intermediate fixture failures repaired in the focused HTTP suites. It is not claimed as a passing gate.

Two unchanged failures were reproduced separately on main: test_podman_supervisor::test_pidfd_is_real_close_on_exec_and_detects_live_process (pidfd_open unavailable on Darwin), and test_projectfs_local_io::test_limits_deadline_names_and_binary_classification (macOS Unicode filename normalization).
Two additional real-Vacuum OpenAPI tests were skipped because vacuum is absent. Cookie gates and real PostgreSQL tests had no selected skips.

A template without http_session_get reports an unconfirmed checkpoint and stops HTTP work; replacement restores only the committed jar. Completed target HTTP outcomes are never replayed for storage repair.
